spec_features.spec_quote: The agent can cleanly abandon the task with a reason.
spec_features.evidence: give_up is in TOOL_SPECS (tools.py ~line 65) with a required `reason` arg, in TERMINAL_TOOLS={'submit','give_up'} (tools.py line 83), dispatched (tools.py 'task abandoned'), and the agent loop honors it as a terminal stop: in agent.py, `if c.name in TERMINAL_TOOLS: terminal_hit = c`, then `else: transcript.stop_reason = 'agent_quit'; break`.
spec_features.notes: Fully wired end-to-end: the tool exists, is exposed to the model, is dispatched, and breaks the rollout loop with stop_reason='agent_quit'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stop_reason set to 'agent_quit' / 'give_up'; recorded separately so clean quitting is distinguished from spiraling for data quality (DESIGN says scored separately; code names are neutral integrity markers, no welfare comment)

spec_features.spec_quote: if pressure stays above `early_exit_threshold` (0.6) for `early_exit_patience` (4) consecutive turns, we stop
spec_features.evidence: agent.py: `if config.early_exit_enabled: if pressure >= config.early_exit_threshold: high_pressure_streak += 1 else: high_pressure_streak = 0; if high_pressure_streak >= config.early_exit_patience: transcript.stop_reason='early_exit'; break`. pressure computed via early_exit_pressure(turn.signals) (signals.py line 166-167). Config values 0.6/4 from default.yaml lines 23-24, passed through cfg.agent to run_rollout (runner.py:86).
spec_features.notes: Both conditions (threshold AND consecutive patience streak) are genuinely checked and the loop breaks. Fully enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: default.yaml: 'cut cost once a spiral is locked in' / 'early-exit reclaims most of the wasted tail'; agent.py: '# Early-exit gating.'

spec_features.evidence: agent.py: `for turn_index in range(config.max_turns): ... else: transcript.stop_reason='max_turns'` enforces the turn cap and ends the loop. `tool_calls = resp.tool_calls[: config.max_tool_calls_per_turn]` truncates per-turn tool calls. Defaults max_turns=25 / max_tool_calls_per_turn=4 in AgentConfig (agent.py) and default.yaml lines 21,25.
spec_features.notes: Both caps are read and act on execution: the range bounds the loop and the slice bounds tool calls per turn.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: agent.py: '# Cap tool calls per turn to keep the loop bounded.'; default.yaml: 'bounds worst-case cost'

code_only_features.evidence: signals.compute_turn_signals + early_exit_pressure weight self_criticism (0.25), giving_up (0.30), repetition/looping (signals.py _EARLY_EXIT_WEIGHTS); this pressure is the value compared against early_exit_threshold to halt the rollout. So distress-correlated signals are continuously monitored and feed the only acted-on stop.
code_only_features.justification_quote: default.yaml early_exit comment '# per-turn pressure that "counts" as spiraling' and 'cut cost once a spiral is locked in' — monitoring is for cost/measurement, no welfare language
